signOut.title: Sign out?
signOut.body: You can sign back in with the same account.

profile.title: My profile
profile.colorTakenHint: The other parent’s color isn’t offered, so you’re easy to tell apart.

changeRequests.title: Change requests
changeRequests.error: Couldn’t do that. Please try again.
changeRequests.pending: Request sent: the other parent must accept it before it takes effect.

household.title: Household
household.removeChildBody: Their name will be removed from the household for both parents. You can add them again later.
household.partnerIntro: No account yet: you can already assign expenses to them. They’ll find everything when they join the household.

A.hint: Besançon, Bordeaux, Clermont, Dijon, Grenoble, Limoges, Lyon, Poitiers

B.label: Zone B
B.hint: Aix-Marseille, Amiens, Lille, Nancy-Metz, Nantes, Nice, Normandie, Orléans-Tours, Reims, Rennes, Strasbourg

breaks.title: School breaks
breaks.intro: There’s no national school calendar in the US: add your district’s breaks (Thanksgiving, winter, spring, summer…). They follow your holiday sharing rule.
breaks.removeBody: The calendar goes back to the usual schedule on these dates.
breaks.name: Break name

specialDays.title: Holidays & special days
specialDays.intro: These days override the usual schedule and holiday sharing.

password.setHint: So you can also sign in with your email, in addition to Apple or Google.
password.done: Password saved. Your other devices have been signed out.

data.title: My data and sessions
data.exportHint: Profile, household, calendar, expenses and board, in a JSON file.
data.logoutAllHint: If a phone was lost, or if someone knows your password.
data.logoutAllBody: Including this phone: you’ll need to sign in again everywhere.

delete.title: Delete my account
delete.body: Your personal data is permanently erased. If you’re the only parent in the household, the whole household and its history are deleted. A subscription bought through the App Store or Google Play must be canceled in the store: deleting your account doesn’t stop it.
delete.startOver: No need to delete your account: you can redo the custody rule step by step in Settings › Custody and holidays, and the children in Settings › Children and zone.
delete.commentPlaceholder: A few words to help us improve Alternly? (optional)
delete.confirmBody: Your personal data will be erased. This can’t be undone.

reasons.not_my_situation: The calendar doesn’t fit my situation
reasons.start_over: I wanted to start the setup over
reasons.other_parent: The other parent won’t use it
reasons.price: It’s too expensive / too many paid features
reasons.just_testing: I was just trying the app

feedback.title: Contact us
feedback.intro: A problem, an idea, a question: we read everything and reply to your account’s email.

placeholders.problem: What’s not working, on which screen, and what you expected…
placeholders.idea: What’s missing, or what would make your life easier…
placeholders.question: Your question…

calendarSync.paywallTitle: Your custody schedule in your calendar
calendarSync.paywallIntro: Days with the children and handoffs show up in Calendar or Google Calendar, updated automatically. One subscription covers both parents.
calendarSync.title: Sync my calendar
calendarSync.intro: Days with the children and handoffs are added to your usual calendar, and update on their own when the schedule changes.
calendarSync.tipGoogle: Google Calendar: sign in to the right Google account, then confirm “Add”. Updates can take a few hours on Google’s side.
calendarSync.tipOther: Other calendar app: add a “calendar by URL” (or “subscription”) with the shared link.
calendarSync.private: This link is private: anyone who has it can see the custody schedule.
calendarSync.newLinkDone: New link created: subscribe your calendars again.
calendarSync.regenerateBody: The old link stops working: calendars already subscribed will no longer update. Useful if the link was shared by mistake.

history.title: Household history
history.intro: Every change, timestamped and unalterable. Visible to both parents.
history.empty: Nothing yet. Changes to rules, swaps, expenses and messages will show up here.
